title: ZINASU protest at Harare Magistrates Court over judicial capture
threshold_50_evidence: Not established: the report identifies a protest but gives no participant count or crowd estimate.

start_date.summary: The retrospective report explicitly dates the protest to 25 January 2021 (p.44, lines 1529–1531).

end_date.summary: The examined passage does not report the assembly's physical end; arrest/detention of leaders is not used as an endpoint.

location.summary: The report locates the protest at Harare Magistrate Court (p.44, line 1530).

scope.summary: A protest at the named Harare court is coded local; no broader scope is stated.

organizer.summary: The report identifies members of Zimbabwe National Students Union (ZINASU).

demands.summary: The report states the protest was over judicial capture; coded political_behavior_process.

participants_original.summary: No participant count or crowd estimate is stated in the examined passage.

participants_min.summary: No numerical lower bound is reported.

participants_max.summary: No numerical upper bound is reported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The report confirms a protest but provides no evidence that at least 50 people attended; threshold remains pending.

protester_violence.summary: The passage gives no account of violence by protesters; unknown.

state_response.summary: The report says police violently disrupted the protest and its leaders were arrested and detained (p.44, lines 1529–1531). Arrests=yes; crowd_dispersal=yes as an attempted disruption, without claiming that everyone was cleared or when the gathering ended. Accommodation, beatings, ignore, killings and shootings are not described and remain unknown.

notes: Retrospective Zimbabwe Human Rights NGO Forum report published June 2022. The report establishes the dated protest and demand, but no crowd size. Its separate 1 February 2021 ZINASU demonstration is outside this unit and is not merged here.
open_questions: When did the physical gathering end, and did police clear the whole group?
Is there an accessible contemporaneous account or primary record?
Independent review and official baseline remain pending.
